newsitem.title: FINLAND: HONKARAKENNE SAYS ORDERSTOCK 40 PCT UP.
newsitem.headline: HONKARAKENNE SAYS ORDERSTOCK 40 PCT UP.

text.p: Finnish prefabricated loghouse maker Honkarakenne Oy said in a statement on Friday its orderstock at 87 million markka was currently 40 percent higher than one year ago.
"The company's orderstock is at the moment 40 percent better than at the corresponding time last year," Honkarakenne said.
"Export sales are good and domestic advance sales for the end of this year are bigger than last year," it said.

Export orders were helped by an agreement to deliver a 1,840 square metre loghouse -- when ready in January 1997 one of the world's biggest of its kind -- to a Dutch transcendental meditation society, it said.
The value of the Dutch order is over 10 million markka.
A foundation supporting the Maharish transcendental meditation society, named after its founder, ordered the loghouse to be used as a training centre, or "meditation temple", Honkarakenne said.
The foundation opted for Honkarakenne's loghouse because of the environmental value of wooden logs.
"A log is a clean, natural material. It is easy to breath in a loghouse," Honkarakenne said.
